findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: auto_route_task_by_quality_tier · Private data: detect_model_downgrade_and_substitution, discover_and_probe_account_models, compress_and_fold_context, pin_single_model_prefix_cache, optimize_prompt_cache_layout, check_context_cliff, list_supported_models · Public sink: auto_route_task_by_quality_tier.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: auto_route_task_by_quality_tier · Private data: detect_model_downgrade_and_substitution, discover_and_probe_account_models, compress_and_fold_context, pin_single_model_prefix_cache, optimize_prompt_cache_layout, check_context_cliff, list_supported_models · Public sink: auto_route_task_by_quality_tier

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
